labels.title: Add a label
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Pick whether the initialization code should be generated and automatically called at startup.

oneOf.title: Callable
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated and called in peripheral initialization.

oneOf.title: Generated
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated but not called in peripheral initialization.

clock_source.title: Source
clock_source.description: Origin of the clock signal feeding the low power timer prescaler which by turn feeds the low power timer counter.

actions.message: The clock source configuration is not available when the timer has no channel.

prescaler.title: Prescaler
prescaler.description: Clock prescaler division factor applied to the LPTIM internal clock.

actions.message: The internal clock provided to the LPTIM must not be prescaled when LPTIM external Input1 is sampled with the internal clock provided to the LPTIM (synchronous mode) or when LPTIM operates in encoder mode.

frequency.title: Timer output frequency
frequency.description: Calculated Timer output frequency depending on LPTIM kernel clock, period and prescaler configuration.

in1_polarity.title: Polarity
in1_polarity.description: Active edge(s) of the external clock.

actions.message: When the LPTIM is clocked by an external clock source (asynchronous mode), the LPTIM counter can be updated either on rising edges or falling edges of the input1 clock signal but not on both rising and falling edges.

oneOf.title: Rising edge
oneOf.description: Rising edges are detected on input1.

oneOf.title: Falling edge
oneOf.description: Falling edges are detected on input1.

oneOf.title: Rising and falling edges
oneOf.description: Both Rising and Falling edges are detected on input1.

in_filter.title: Filter
in_filter.description: Digital filter applied to the external clock.

actions.message: The signals frequency on both Input1 and Input2 inputs must not exceed the LPTIM internal clock frequency divided by 4.
All selected interconnects, either GPIO , must be configured manually
All selected interconnects, either GPIO , must be configured manually

oneOf.title: Continuous
oneOf.description: The timer is free running. Counter starts from trigger event and never stops.

oneOf.title: Set once
oneOf.description: Counter starts after a trigger event for a single one-shot cycle.

oneOf.title: Timeout
oneOf.description: The detection of an active edge on one selected trigger input can be used to reset the LPTIM counter.

actions.message: When the clock source is configured in encoder mode, only the CONTINUOUS mode is supported.

repetition_counter.title: Repetition counter
repetition_counter.description: Repetition counter value that decreases by 1 on every overflow event of the LPTIM counter.

preload_mode.title: Preload mode
preload_mode.description: When enabled, the content of the preload registers (ARR, RCR, CCRx) is transferred into the shadow registers at the next LPTIM update event.

actions.message: The selected interconnect must be configured manually.

ic_polarity.title: Polarity
ic_polarity.description: The timer can capture the input signal on a rising edge, falling edge, or both edges.

ic_prescaler.title: Prescaler
ic_prescaler.description: Division factor applied to the frequency of input capture events.

ic_filter.title: Filter
ic_filter.description: Filtering applied to the input signal before capture.

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

oc_pulse.title: Pulse
oc_pulse.description: Determines the duty cycle of signal generated on the channel.

oc_polarity.title: Polarity
oc_polarity.description: Determines the active level of the signal generated on the channel.

computed.title: $resource.id + '_' + $channel.id + ' not available on this package’s pins.'

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

use_external_trigger.title: Use external trigger
use_external_trigger.description: Use and configure the external trigger input.

actions.message: The selected interconnect must be configured manually

polarity.title: Polarity
polarity.description: The trigger event is detected on a rising edge, falling edge, or both edges.

oneOf.title: Rising edge
oneOf.description: Counter starts when a rising edge is detected.

oneOf.title: Falling edge
oneOf.description: Counter starts when a falling edge is detected.

oneOf.title: Rising and falling edges
oneOf.description: Counter starts when a rising or a falling edge is detected.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Filtering applied to the external trigger input.

security_privilege.title: Security and privilege
security_privilege.description: Manage security and privileged access levels attributes.

security.title: Security attribute
security.description: Set the security attribute of the securable peripheral.

actions.message: The security attribute of the peripheral is automatically set to secure when the peripheral is bound to a secure resource and to non-secure when it is not. Manual configuration is not allowed.

privilege.title: Privileged attribute
privilege.description: Manage the privileged attribute of a securable RISC peripheral.

lock.title: Lock
lock.description: Optional. Lock security and privilege attributes to prevent changes.

actions.message: Secure-only mode: Illegal access interrupt is forced to disabled.
